routes.name: Entry for listed African countries
routes.summary: Citizens of Benin, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Gabon, Equatorial Guinea, Congo, Nigeria and Niger can enter with a valid passport or an authorization. Everyone else needs a visa.

other: The embassy page says passport 'or authorization'. Stay length not stated. Confirm with a Chad embassy.

sources.label: Embassy of Chad in Canada, visa notice

routes.name: Chad Visa (embassy)
routes.summary: Most foreigners need a visa from a Chad embassy. It comes as 1 month single entry, 3 months multiple entry or 6 months multiple entry.

other: Fee tables on the Canada embassy site are unclear about who pays which. Foreigner fees appear to be CAD 150, 200 and 250 for the 1, 3 and 6 month visas. Other embassies may charge different amounts.

documents: Passport with at least 2 blank pages
Employer letter stating purpose and departure date
Round-trip ticket or travel agency reservation
routes.processing: About 7 working days. Express in 1 or 3 days costs extra.
